_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. Do not copy to experiment_baseline.json until a real documented observation and numeric baseline exist. Do not invent metrics, hypothesis outcomes, or source. experiment_loop.py loads only experiment_baseline.json and rejects invented/placeholder sources. Validate a filled copy with: python3 tools/experiment_template_validator.py experiment_baseline.json
hypothesis: TEMPLATE: replace with a testable hypothesis, e.g. A stronger opening hook will raise average view duration on the first 30 seconds
source: TEMPLATE: replace with a documented source such as 'YouTube Studio analytics for video XYZ on 2026-09-15'
notes: change must be one of: hook, mechanism_framing, example_density, title_promise, visual_explanation, pacing, cta, topic_selection. baseline must be numeric for a real file. source must not contain invented/assumed/placeholder/guess. See tools/experiment_loop.py load_baseline.
